name: Tonarizuma
source:
Expert system engineer Yosuke stumbles upon an AV on the net. The woman on it looks exactly like newlywed wife next door. One day he rapes his neighbor when they stay alone. She wants to stay loyal to her husband, but body accepts Yosuke eagerly for some reason. The forbidden insult story takes place at all kinds of locations without awareness that they are being watched.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-april-2005-sanarara.html]vndbreview[/url]]
